title: Compact onboarding asset pack for API/SDK quickstart (auth, keys, streaming, tool-calls)
creator: Ariella Gomez
description: Create a small, reusable asset pack for the API/SDK quickstart that covers: authentication/key usage, streaming responses (client-side), and tool-calling examples. Assets should be compact, visually consistent with Redwood branding, and easy for docs engineers to drop into both hosted API and Dedicated/Private docs. Deliverables include vector and raster exports, annotated source frames for engineering handoff, and a short style guide excerpt for usage.
acceptance_criteria: Four primary hero assets: auth-key-flow, ephemeral-token-snippet, streaming-lifecycle, tool-calling-diagram exported as SVG and 2 PNG resolutions
All assets added to the quickstart docs repo and referenced in the PR description
Figma file with named frames and component variants shared with Docs/Engineering and linked in this ticket
Illustration style notes (colors, icon rules, spacing) documented in a single markdown resource
Design sign-off received from PM and Docs before closing
assets: compact-hero-auth-keyflow.svg — simplified horizontal auth flow for quickstart header (shows API key creation, header usage, ephemeral token arrow)
compact-hero-streaming.png — frame sequence (3 panels) showing client open stream, tokens arriving, client render + small caption overlay
compact-diagram-toolcalls.svg — component diagram illustrating model -> tool adapter -> external tool -> model loop with arrows and short labels
code-overlay-ephemeral-token.png — 2x raster with highlighted cURL and SDK snippet for ephemeral key exchange
figma-source-compact-onboarding.fig — single-page Figma with component variants, color tokens, and export presets
style-excerpt.md — short markdown file describing spacing, color tokens, icon usage, and do/don't examples for docs writers
design_notes: Prioritized compact, horizontal layouts to reduce vertical real estate in docs hero areas
Avoid photorealistic elements to keep file size small and ensure consistency with product screenshots
Use three-step metaphors for streaming and tool-calling to make complex behavior digestible
Opt for single-color iconography with small accent token to match Redwood brand palette
Export PNG at 2x for retina and an optimized web 1x for smaller pages; SVGs should be the source for docs when possible
